outcome: cord blood hematological parameters (erythrocyte and leukocyte values, reticulocyte hemoglobin content)
cohort: 439 newborn infants with gestational age ranging from 34 to 42 weeks
finding: Newborn infants from vaginal delivery and preterm infants showed higher erythrocyte and leukocytes values, while reticulocyte hemoglobin content was not influenced by gender, gestational age, and delivery route.
